title: Product Manager
description:
Lab49 is an award winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.

We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.

Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier-one investment banks and many of the largest buy-side firms globally.

Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production.

We are seeking a Product Manager, who will be working with our clients in the high frequency trading space. One who has the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; .

### **Responsibilities**

* Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; should be comfortable facilitating discussions and working on cross-functional teams.
* Process Design: Lead sessions to understand current state processes and pain points; leverage this analysis and understand key requirements to help shape the future state process design and gain alignment across HCM and business stakeholders.
* Analytical Skills and Data Acumen: Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making. They should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and other reporting tools to analyze data.
* Requirements gathering and documentation acumen: Ability to gather, document and clearly articulate product requirements (i.e., user stories, data migration requirements, etc.).
* Technical Aptitude: Candidate should have a basic understanding of software development principles and be comfortable working with technical teams.
* Test Strategy & Execution: Work with functional and technical teams to shape the end-to-end testing strategy, spanning functional test and UAT; help test solution rigorously (along with HCM and business stakeholders) to surface and resolve critical defects ahead of a program’s launch
* Project & Change Management: Help project manage key deliverables, while helping execute against an innovative communication and training strategy – from drafting stakeholder messaging to creating high-quality learning collateral
* Understanding of Total Rewards Concepts (optional – specific to Rewards pillar): A foundational understanding of total rewards principles, including compensation structures, benefits packages (health, retirement, etc.), and other employee benefits is ideal.
* Oracle Core experience (optional): Foundational knowledge and understanding of Oracle HRIS including data management, system optimization and functionality

**Why Lab49?**

Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:

You will define new models for building, launching, and scaling AI-driven solutions that help enterprises automate workflows, personalize customer interactions, and unlock new business opportunities. You will partner with engineering, design, data science, and business teams to deliver meaningful AI-powered product experiences for enterprise clients. The team operates with close proximity to APAC markets, fostering strong partnerships. Expect a collaborative, people-centered environment with experienced teammates who value mentorship and knowledge sharing.This position offers a opportunity to shape AI-enabled enterprise products at global scale while being rooted in one of the world's most dynamic regions. If you're excited by bringing cutting-edge AI capabilities to enterprise customers and driving real business transformation, you'll thrive here.

* 8+ years of Product Management experience

* Track record shipping products that drove measurable business outcomes for enterprise customers
* Experience developing and scaling AI-native strategies including evals and data strategies across teams

title: Senior Product Manager, Payer Content Solutions and Analytics
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and execution of payer content solutions and supporting reporting and analytics capabilities. This role will be responsible for driving API-based content products that help healthcare payer and provider organizations improve operational efficiency, reduce denials, lower administrative costs, and enhance customer experiences.

The ideal candidate combines solid product management expertise with deep healthcare domain knowledge, particularly within claims, benefits, prior authorization, policy management, and revenue cycle operations. This individual will work cross-functionally with engineering, operations, clinical, sales, and client-facing teams to deliver innovative, market-ready solutions that produce measurable business outcomes.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product Strategy and Roadmap
  + Define and execute product strategy for payer content solutions and associated reporting and analytics capabilities
  + Develop and maintain product roadmaps aligned to business objectives, market opportunities, customer needs, and measurable outcomes
  + Identify opportunities to improve denial reduction, cost savings, call deflection, and operational efficiency through innovative content and analytics solutions
* Product Development and Delivery
  + Translate payer and provider business challenges into scalable API content products, reporting capabilities, and actionable product requirements
  + Partner with engineering, operations, and other stakeholders to define features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements
  + Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation through Alpha, Beta, and General Availability (GA) releases
  + Define MVP scope, prioritize product backlogs, and ensure successful execution using Agile methodologies and product management tools
* Customer and Market Engagement
  + Collaborate with payer and provider clients to identify business needs, validate use cases, and gather product feedback
  + Ensure product capabilities align with real-world healthcare workflows, systems, and operational requirements
  + Conduct market and competitive research to identify emerging trends and opportunities within healthcare content, API-driven solutions, and analytics
* Cross-Functional Leadership
  + Drive alignment across product, engineering, operations, clinical, delivery, and go-to-market teams
  + Provide regular updates to executive leadership and key stakeholders on product performance, roadmap progress, and delivery milestones
  + Coordinate product readiness activities to support successful launches and customer adoption
* Product Enablement and Support
  + Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for payer content solutions and analytics products
  + Support the development of customer-facing and internal product documentation, training materials, and support resources
  + Partner with sales and marketing teams to strengthen product positioning, sales enablement, and go-to-market activities
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of product management experience with ownership of complex enterprise software or platform products
* Experience developing and managing healthcare technology products, preferably within payer, provider, revenue cycle, or healthcare operations environments
* Demonstrated experience with API-based products, content sourcing strategies, or platform-based solutions
* Experience defining product use cases and working closely with engineering teams to deliver scalable product capabilities
* Experience with reporting and analytics platforms, including performance measurement, KPI development, and operational reporting
* Solid understanding of Agile product development methodologies and tools such as Rally, Aha!, Jira, or similar platforms
* Proven excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with healthcare content products, claims intelligence, policy content, pricing transparency, or related healthcare information services
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale healthcare platforms serving multiple customer segments
* Deep knowledge of payer and provider operations, including:
  + Claims processing
  + Benefits management
  + Prior authorization
  + Policy and editing logic
  + Revenue cycle management
  + Denial management
  + Call center operations
* Familiarity with emerging AI, automation, and agentic workflow solutions within healthcare technology

**Key Success Factors**

* The successful candidate will demonstrate:
* Solid product management leadership and execution
* Subject matter expertise in healthcare claims content and payer/provider workflows
* Ability to translate complex healthcare operational challenges into customer-focused product solutions
* Experience leveraging reporting and analytics data to drive product decisions, measure outcomes, and optimize performance
* Proven success working across diverse stakeholders to deliver high-impact products that drive business growth and customer value

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

You are a product leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution You have a deep understanding of healthcare claims and payer/provider operations, excel at transforming market needs into scalable product capabilities, and are passionate about using data, analytics, APIs, and emerging technologies to solve complex healthcare challenges.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Product Manager / Senior Product Manager – AI to lead the strategy, development, and implementation of AI-driven products that transform customer and merchant experiences across our payments ecosystem. The role will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Business teams to develop next-generation solutions powered by large language models (LLMs) and other generative AI technologies.

Nice to Have
  
  
Experience with prompt engineering and fine-tuning LLMs.
  
Background in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering.
  
Familiarity with payment ecosystems, risk modelling, and fraud analytics.

You’ll set strategy, prioritization, and experimentation for payment selection, flexibility, authorization performance, and recovery across web, mobile web, and native apps. * Build a rigorous experimentation program, from hypothesis and A/B testing through measurement and scaled rollout of winners.
* Define and deliver AI capabilities such as personalized payment recommendations, intelligent routing, failure prediction, next-best-action recovery, and anomaly detection, partnering with Data Science and Engineering on model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and safe rollout.
* Partner with Payments platform teams to ensure reliable, scalable, reusable capabilities across pay-in, authentication, orchestration, and payment status.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights (conversion, payment and authentication success, support contacts, customer feedback) to prioritize opportunities and measure impact.
Balance traveler experience against cost, authorization performance, fraud and risk, regulatory needs, and operational efficiency, while aligning multiple EG brands and communicating strategy, risks, and decisions to senior leaders.  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* 8 + years of product management experience, with a strong track record building, scaling, or transforming payment products.
* Expert knowledge of the payments ecosystem: payment methods, PSPs, authorization and declines, 3DS, tokenization, wallets, routing, refunds, and failure recovery.
* Proven success designing and optimizing high-converting checkout and payment-selection experiences across web, mobile web, and native apps, using experimentation, analytics, and customer research.
* Experience applying AI/ML to customer-facing products (personalization, decisioning, fraud prevention, optimization), with practical understanding of model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and responsible rollout.
Excellent communication and ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization, with strong analytical skills, product judgment on trade-offs, and a bias toward measurable outcomes.

### **About Us**

At **ideaForge Technology**, we are pioneering the future of autonomous flight. We design, manufacture, and deploy cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) that solve complex challenges across industries—from defence, homeland security and infrastructure inspection to emergency response and delivery.

As an Assistant Product Manager (APM) / Product Manager (PM) for the Small Hybrid Verticals portfolio within the Switch UAV family, you will own the product lifecycle, strategy, and market performance for this critical product line. You will report to the Senior Product Manager and operate as a leader within the product management function, bridging customer demand (defense, paramilitary, state agencies) with engineering capability, manufacturing constraints, and regulatory certification requirements.

This role blends strategic product development with hands-on execution across requirements, regulatory alignment (DGCA, FCC, BlueUAS Certification), business planning, and cross-functional team leadership. You will drive the product roadmap from market research through production at scale, managing trade-offs between performance, cost, compliance, and customer needs.

### **Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership**

* Develop and execute the multi-year product roadmap for Small Hybrid Verticals. Define product variants, performance tiers, and feature evolution across the Switch family. Work with engineering leadership to balance feature requests, technical feasibility, development timelines, and manufacturing capacity.

* Drive business cases for new initiatives (new variants, payload integrations, airframe configurations). Forecast revenue, unit economics, and market penetration for roadmap milestones.

### **Customer & Market Intelligence**

* Conduct ongoing market research across Indian defense buyers (Army Aviation, BRO, state police, paramilitary forces) and international defense bodies. Translate customer pain points and operational requirements into product requirements documents (PRDs).

* Support sales and business development teams with tender responses, feature positioning documents, and pricing justification. Participate in customer demonstrations and technical discussions to validate requirements.

### **Regulatory Certification & Compliance Leadership**

* Ensure product design, documentation, and testing align with aviation regulations. Prepare certification-readiness reports and mitigate compliance risks early in the development cycle.

* Manage dependencies with external regulatory bodies and escalate blockers to senior leadership.

### **Cross-Functional Program Leadership**

* Lead integrated product development programs with hardware (airframe, propulsion, avionics), electronics, software, and manufacturing teams. Facilitate requirements clarity, dependency tracking, and milestone achievement.

* Chair product review meetings, design reviews, and launch readiness gates. Escalate technical risks and resolve trade-offs between cost, performance, and timeline.

* Mentor junior product team members and interns. Provide guidance on requirements gathering, market analysis, and business case development.

### **Cost, Pricing & Business Performance**

* Conduct cost-of-goods analysis for Small Hybrid Verticals. Build bottom-up cost stacks including BOM, labor, overhead, and manufacturing yield. Identify cost-reduction opportunities across design, sourcing, and manufacturing.

* Define pricing strategy and margin targets in alignment with MoD procurement patterns, competitive positioning, and profitability objectives.

* Track product P&L, unit economics, and market performance against forecast. Provide monthly/quarterly business reviews to senior leadership.

### **Go-to-Market & Launch Strategy**

* Develop go-to-market plans for new variants or airframe configurations. Define launch messaging, positioning, channel strategy, and customer communication.

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Integrations
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models.

Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources.

This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.
* Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.
* Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.
* Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.
* Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.
* Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures.
* Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information.
* Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows.
* A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer.
* Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.
* Clear communication about customer problems, close collaboration with engineering, and a habit of using data to evaluate adoption.
* Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required.

**About the team**
------------------

We're part of GitLab's Core Data Products organization, which focuses on insights, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. You'll report to the Vice President of Product Management and join as our third product manager, focused on Data Integrations. You'll work alongside a Principal Product Manager responsible for the Data Insights Platform and dashboards, and a Product Manager focused on Orbit.

GitLab is all-remote, with asynchronous collaboration across regions. Transparency, written communication, and clear decisions are central to how we work. This role has the Bangalore location and in-person requirements described above.

#### **How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

**Privacy Policy:** Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

As a Senior Technical Product Manager for AI Products & Solutions, you'll set the vision and roadmap for AI-powered products and run delivery for them. These include generative AI copilots, agentic digital workers and intelligent automation used across healthcare operations such as claims, prior authorization, member, provider operations and care administration. * Stakeholder management: Present status, risks and outcomes to executive leadership. Build alignment across technology, operations and business teams
* Adoption and change management: Drive enablement through demos, office hours, documentation, FAQs and feedback loops

* Certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP or AI/ML certifications

* Customer focus
* Data-driven decisions

**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**What you'll do:**

* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours?
* You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
* When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

**What we're looking for:**

* You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
* You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
* You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
* You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
* You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

**Experience**

* 5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
* At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
* Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
* Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead products and capabilities that measure national and local television audiences across linear broadcast, cable, and streaming environments. This role sits at the intersection of media measurement, data science, technology, and client needs—turning complex viewing signals into trusted, actionable audience insights for programmers, advertisers, agencies, and other media stakeholders.

The ideal candidate understands how television is bought, sold, distributed, and measured across fragmented platforms. You will define product strategy, translate industry requirements into an actionable roadmap, and guide cross-functional teams from concept through launch and ongoing improvement.

What you’ll do

* Own product strategy and roadmap for cross-platform television audience measurement capabilities spanning national and local markets.
* Translate customer, market, and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, success metrics, and prioritized investments.
* Partner with data science, engineering, research, operations, sales, and customer success to deliver scalable, reliable measurement products.
* Drive measurement solutions across linear and streaming environments, including audience estimates, reach and frequency, impressions, demographic reporting, time-shifted viewing, and deduplicated cross-platform audiences.

* Lead discovery with clients and industry stakeholders to identify unmet needs and validate product direction.

* Communicate product vision, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders and cross-functional partners.

* 6+ years of experience in product management, media measurement, audience analytics, advertising technology, streaming, or a related field.

* Strong understanding of television and video ecosystems, including broadcast, cable, streaming, connected TV, local markets, ad-supported programming, and media buying.

You will help shape the next generation of television audience measurement as viewing continues to fragment across traditional and streaming platforms. title: Senior Principal - Product Owner - EUC/MDM
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
Own the product for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries get, use and are supported on their devices — with particular depth on the mobile estate: iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and the field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices that behave nothing like them.

This is a product role, not a project role. The Senior Product Owner owns the vision, the backlog and the outcomes — deciding what gets built and why, in what order, and being accountable for whether it actually improved anything. Success is measured in adoption, effort saved and experience improved, not in tickets closed or features shipped.

The role sits between three constituencies that rarely agree: employees who want their devices to just work, Security who want them locked down, and Finance who want them cheaper. Turning that tension into a prioritised, defensible backlog is the core of the job.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and articulate the product vision for end user services and mobile device management — a clear statement of what the service will be in 18 months and why that matters to the business.
* Maintain a rolling roadmap that balances new capability, technical debt, security and compliance obligations, and experience improvement; keep it honest about capacity.
* Translate the EUC strategy and architecture direction into a sequenced, deliverable product backlog.
* Own the business case and benefits realisation for product investment; be accountable for the value claimed, not just the spend approved.
* Own, refine and prioritise the product backlog as the single source of truth for the squad; make prioritisation calls transparently and defend them.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from and testers can verify — specific about the outcome, not prescriptive about the solution.
* Lead sprint planning, refinement, review and retrospective alongside the Scrum Master; accept or reject work against acceptance criteria.
* Manage dependencies across adjacent squads — identity, security, networking, service management — and escalate early when they threaten delivery.
* Own the release and change approach for user-visible change, including pilot rings, communications and rollback triggers.
* Be the voice of the employee in every prioritisation conversation, and hold the evidence to back it: research, telemetry, ticket analysis and direct observation.
* Run continuous discovery — user interviews, shadowing in the field and on the shop floor, surveys, usability testing — with the populations who are least like head office.
* Convert digital experience (DEX) telemetry and service desk data into prioritised, root-cause-addressing backlog items; treat every recurring ticket category as a product defect until proven otherwise.
* Own adoption: define what good adoption looks like before launch, measure it after, and act when it does not materialise.
* Own the product for the mobile estate: enrolment and provisioning experience, BYOD vs. corporate-owned models, app catalogue and distribution, and the employee-facing side of mobile security policy.
* Own the BYOD proposition end to end — the privacy commitment, the employee terms, the enrolment journey and the trust that makes people willing to participate.
* Manage the mobile OS release cycle as a recurring product event: annual iOS and Android major releases, beta assessment, compatibility validation and controlled rollout.
* Own the product relationship with mobile carriers, MDM platform vendors and app suppliers.
* Build and maintain relationships across business units, regions and functions; run a stakeholder forum or product council that makes trade-offs visible rather than fought in private.
* Partner with Cyber Security to land control changes in ways employees will accept and comply with — security outcomes delivered through good product design rather than mandate.
* Engage works councils, employee representatives and Privacy where mobile telemetry, BYOD or device monitoring is in scope.
* Report on product performance to senior stakeholders in outcome terms.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
* Product ownership certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe POPM, Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), ITIL v4 Foundation, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership at scale for end user services and mobile device management, with direct working familiarity with an enterprise MDM/UEM platform (e.g., Microsoft Intune).
* Mobile estate strategy across iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and specialised field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices.
* Digital employee experience (DEX) and service-desk-driven product improvement, using telemetry and ticket analysis to prioritise root-cause fixes.

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and 12+ years in technology delivery, including 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager with genuine backlog authority (not a business analyst writing another team's requirements).
* Product or service ownership serving 10,000+ users across multiple countries.
* Demonstrable hands-on product experience in end user computing, digital workplace or mobile device management — including direct familiarity with an enterprise MDM/UEM platform.
* Sustained experience owning a backlog for a cross-functional agile squad, through multiple release cycles, in a scaled delivery environment.
* Track record of using user research and quantitative telemetry to drive prioritisation, with a specific example of a decision the data changed.
* A demonstrable product outcome delivered and measured — adoption, experience, effort or cost — not merely a feature shipped.
* Proven ability to manage senior and conflicting stakeholders across business units and regions, and to hold a prioritisation decision under pressure.
* Fluent English; credible with both engineers and executives in a global matrixed organisation.
* Willingness to travel internationally, approximately [10–15]% of the time — including to sites, labs and field locations where the devices are actually used.
* Desirable:
* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — including GxP-validated systems and the change control that comes with them.
* Product ownership for specialised or frontline mobile devices: rugged handhelds, lab and clinical devices, field-force tablets, shared/kiosk devices, scanners and shop-floor endpoints.
* Experience with deskless and frontline worker populations — employees without a corporate laptop, whose primary device is shared or personal.
* Works council and employee-representation engagement, particularly on BYOD, mobile telemetry and device monitoring.
* Mobile app product experience — internal app store curation, in-house mobile app lifecycle, MAM policy design.
* Experience delivering a major platform migration or transition as a product owner — MDM platform change, MSP transition, or BYOD programme launch.
* Service design or UX research background; journey mapping and service blueprinting.
* Carrier and telecom management — mobile contracts, eSIM, international roaming, expense management.
* AI-enabled workplace tooling product experience — Copilot, virtual agents, AI-assisted support deflection.
* Accessibility and assistive technology as a designed-in part of the device proposition.
* Sustainability — device longevity, refurbishment and circular IT built into the product roadmap.

**Skills/Background**

* Deep product craft across backlog ownership, outcome-based requirements, continuous discovery, and value definition and measurement.
* Endpoint management platform fluency (Microsoft Intune or comparable MDM/UEM tooling) — enough to have credible conversations with engineers and challenge estimates.
* Understanding of endpoint security fundamentals — conditional access, compliance policy, encryption — and the trade-offs each imposes on the user.
* Fluency in agile delivery tooling (Azure DevOps, Jira, ServiceNow) — able to run a backlog others can actually read.
* Influence without authority — landing decisions across engineering, security, service delivery, regions and vendors through evidence and relationship.
* Communication — equally credible in a sprint refinement and in a steering committee; able to translate technical constraint into business consequence.
